title: Keep a single source of truth per piece of state
guideline: Use @State for local view state, @Observable/@StateObject for shared model state owned by one view

title: Break large views into small, composable views
guideline: Extract subviews when a body closure grows large; SwiftUI diffs and re-renders more efficiently

title: Use NavigationStack with a typed path for navigation
guideline: Drive navigation via a path array/enum for deep-linking and programmatic control

title: Conform list data to Identifiable with a stable id
guideline: Avoid using array index as id for List/ForEach over mutable/reorderable data

title: Prefer implicit animation modifiers for simple cases
guideline: Use .animation(value:) tied to specific state changes rather than blanket global animation

title: Provide accessibility labels for custom controls
guideline: Set .accessibilityLabel/.accessibilityHint on icon-only or custom-drawn controls

title: Support Dynamic Type for text scaling
guideline: Use built-in text styles (.body, .headline) so text scales with the user's accessibility settings
